<!-- generated by scripts/cli-reference.mjs from `goback docs`; do not edit -->

Keep commits, trees or files regardless of retention

```sh
goback [global flags] pin <command>
```

## pin add

Pin a ref

```sh
goback [global flags] pin add [flags] <ref>
```

| Flag | Description | Environment | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--meta value` | key=value label recorded in the object; repeatable |  |  |

## pin list

List the live pins

```sh
goback [global flags] pin list
```

## pin remove

Tombstone a pin

```sh
goback [global flags] pin remove <pin-ref>
```
